adjudication_summary: Worker-4/6 re-review completed source-reviewed adjudication for ZM-804: all 61 linked APD6/DBAASP rows were reconciled against paper-local XML/PDF/supplement/database materials, abbreviation-only Table 2 mismatches were resolved, the true hemolysis and APD6 summary mismatches were preserved as source_conflict cautions, and final review now closes rwk-complete-test-0001 without promoting unsupported values.

supplementary_assets.status: reviewed_pdf_supplement_text; supplement contains strains/vectors/primers/prediction tables and no additional MIC/MBC/toxicity value table that changes adjudication

materials_exhausted.note: Bounded best-effort local recovery exhausted the source surfaces relevant to worker-4/6 blockers; no blocking material gap remains for final adjudication.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: All 61 linked database rows were reviewed. 58 rows are source_verified; 3 remain source_conflict cautions for the DBAASP hemolysis concentration/value mismatch and APD6 summary toxicity-threshold wording not explicitly recoverable from local primary text.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: The 28 Table 2 MIC/MBC rows remain source-supported with units and locators; final activity also records paper-local hemolysis values needed to adjudicate the database conflict. Supplement text did not add a separate activity/toxicity value table.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is narrowed to directly supported membrane association and qualitative membrane disruption from FITC/confocal plus SEM/TEM evidence; in planta protection remains efficacy context, not a separate molecular target.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_4_publication_review: The open worker-4/6 rework ticket is resolved by source-reviewed database and final adjudication artifacts with explicit cautions; no blocking or major QC failure remains.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP reports 10% hemolysis at 512 µM; local primary text supports 10% at 256 µM and 14.32% at 512 µM, so both linked DBAASP hemolysis rows remain source_conflict.
APD6 AP03760 summary is source-supported for sequence/Table 1 properties/Table 2 MICs, but HC50 >500 µM and ~100 µM hemolysis wording is not explicitly recoverable in local XML/PDF text.
Primary source frames ZM-804 as recovered from maize B73 cDNA and then synthesized for assays; APD6 and DBAASP encode different origin contexts, preserved in database sequence checks.
Supplementary PDF text was checked; it contains strains/vectors/primer/prediction/supporting-method tables, not a hidden MIC/MBC/toxicity table that changes final values.
Mechanism conclusions are qualitative membrane association/disruption; no figure-only numeric mechanism quantification is promoted.
